title: Adjust screen brightness
summary: Use brightnessctl to change your screen's brightness level. You can set it to a specific percentage or increase/decrease it by a certain amount.

steps.explain: Set the screen brightness to a specific percentage (e.g., 50%).

placeholders.name: PERCENTAGE
placeholders.description: The desired brightness level as a number between 0 and 100.

alternatives.explain: Increase the current brightness by a specific percentage.

placeholders.name: PERCENTAGE
placeholders.description: The amount to increase brightness by.

alternatives.explain: Decrease the current brightness by a specific percentage.

placeholders.name: PERCENTAGE
placeholders.description: The amount to decrease brightness by.
